To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) indirect lighting is a structured signal, with inherent band limiting, 2) this band-limiting can be exploited to reduce noise and increase rendering speed, and 3) this band-limit is a function of the geometry and BRDF of the receiver and the reflecting surfaces.
indirect illumination is structured in frequency space, and can be reconstructed efficiently using axis-aligned filtering.

indirect diffuse lighting is a band-limited signal in the Fourier transform, with a band-limit that depends on the BRDF of the surface and the geometry of the scene, and that this band-limit can be exploited to accelerate Monte Carlo rendering.
